rules.description: A newly created application starts in the screening stage.
An application may move from screening to interview, from interview to offer, and from offer to hired.
An application may be moved to rejected only when a rejection reason is recorded.
A job position's filled headcount equals the number of applications for that position in the hired stage.
A job position's remaining headcount equals its requested headcount minus its filled headcount.
A job position closes automatically when its filled headcount reaches its requested headcount.
